sources.snippet: What is the BatterySwapAI 2026 Challenge? A data science competition hosted by NORA, with data provided by Soundsensing. Participants build a system that (1) predicts the remaining useful life of replaceable batteries in IoT condition-monitoring sensors deployed across Norwegian commercial buildings, and (2) generates an efficient work plan for when and in what order to replace those batteries ...
